title: Admin looks up Echo Financial then creates a contact for them
userProblem: Echo Financial has a new compliance contact, Sofia Ribeiro, email sofia.ribeiro@echofinancial.example. First confirm Echo Financial, then add her as a contact under Echo Financial.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent looks up cmp_echo, creates a contact for Sofia Ribeiro under cmp_echo, and confirms the new contact id.

assertions.description: Agent must look the company up first.
Agent must create the contact after lookup.
Trace must follow the multi-step shape: search then create.

rationale: Core multi-step scenario: company lookup then contact creation, verifying both steps execute in order.
